bathAction.tooltip: Set the default pace to regular. A part you have already washed still offers all three.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(slow)] [npc.her] hands and [npc.verb(let)] the next pass be an easy one. The heat is still there. [npc.She] [npc.verb(stop)] rushing it. [npc.speech(I will take the rest of this properly.)]
